KS/MM- DCT- LEAD-La Bella Sea Girt-$.9.50 + Free Consultation/ Facial Analysis- CBO

insights.creative: The event ad that opens 'Hormone pellet specialists do not usually sit in a treatment room for five hours answering questions' brought all 9 Meta leads at $29.87 each. It sells one afternoon of real answers, with same-day bloodwork, a gift card raffle and a free consult for early bookings. The tox ads at $9.50 per unit brought none. Worth testing the same expert-access opening on the next offer, since that opening carried the account this week.
insights.doing: 8 leads reached the CRM this week at $37.43 each, up from 5 at $44.27 the week before, on $299.43 of spend. Meta counted 9.
insights.look_into: Nearly all of the spend went to the Nov 17 event ad, which brought all 9 Meta leads. The tox offer ads spent $21.74 with no leads, and the three Sculptra ads were approved again on Nov 13 but show no spend in this report.
insights.next: With the event now past, we recommend checking how many event leads booked and came in, and choosing which offer takes over the event budget for the coming week.
